violations.text: Milks for coffee were observed held at 49 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and placed into other refrigeration during time of inspection. Methods to keep coffee creamers at adequate temperature reviewed Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Containers of icecream in the freezer and cases of sprinkles and cans were observed stored on the floor in the back area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The floors around and under equipment in the service area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Oatmilk and cream were observed held at 51 and 47 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and placed into other refrigeration during time of inspection. Methods to keep coffee creamers at adequate temperature reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of various equipment (interior and exterior) and surrounding areas have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2025
2nd restroom does not have hot water available at handsink. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2025
